Chapter.Label: ch:InstallationAndAuxiliaryFunctions
Chapter.Heading: Installation and Auxiliary Functions
Chapter.Section:
Requirements
This version of &Iterators; needs at least &GAP; 4.10.2 with the default set of included packages. It is completely written in the &GAP; language, and can be used on all platforms for which &GAP; is available. However, some functionality requires the program primecount by Kim Walisch to be installed on the system.

Installation
Like any other &GAP; package, &Iterators; is usually installed in the pkg subdirectory of the &GAP; distribution. This is accomplished by extracting the distribution file in this directory. As usual, you can load &Iterators; via LoadPackage( "iterators" );.
